newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up 13 cents on London's rebound.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up 13 cents on London's rebound.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rebounded to close 13 cents higher at 14.16 ringgit ($5.64) a kg, helped by a $125-rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.
The market had fallen to a 24-1/2-month low of 14.03 ringgit on Monday.
"The rise was in line with a sharp rebound in London last night," a trader said, noting buying from Europe, Japan and Malaysia. Turnover was 128 tonnes, against 117 on Monday.
The local price premium over LME has narrowed to $50 a tonne from $135 previously, traders said. ($1=2.5090 ringgit)
